notes.title: Our Next Game Just Dropped!
notes.content:
[h3][b]There are a lot of cuties in The Last Act, and a lot of cuties in our new game Love's Crescendo too, featuring character art by the same artist![/b][/h3]

[h2]📣Today is the launch day for Love's Crescendo 📣[/h2]
We're pleased to present our latest game, Love's Crescendo, a cozy rhythm game visual novel about finding true love and reigniting that spark for your passions. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38931050/be55528878e2c511409736b85a248ffc6f85b303.png[/img]

[h2]🎹 Play Rhythm Games with an Original Soundtrack 🎹[/h2]
Love's Crescendo features 10 magnificent, original songs by our composers. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38931050/3e2c9090cf7d55a04cb3b7003afcb0848f1e5128.png[/img]

[h2]💿 Jukebox 💿[/h2]
Love's Crescendo has replay value! Play the rhythm games outside of the story via the jukebox for an unlimited amount of fun~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38931050/bceab64c88866ea744f12e7680a8874077150adb.png[/img]

[h2]💕31,000+ words of wholesome sapphic romance 💕 [/h2]
Our story features two lovely ladies as they fall in love, both with their music and with each other. <3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38931050/471799cadf662708a9d2cef60e39fce4b2d9cb08.png[/img]

[h2]🎨8 Vibrant CGs🎨[/h2]
We have 8 CGs that perfectly capture the moments in the story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38931050/3fa213eab2eef3cb2e2c66ee28de8e8bd7ac2550.png[/img]

[h2]☕ A cozy gaming experience ☕[/h2]
Overall, we wanted Love's Crescendo to be a cozy gaming experience where players can enjoy a non-competitive rhythm game alongside a heartwarming story. If you're looking for a rhythm game that's low-stress, this one is perfect for you. It's okay if you don't get perfect scores, it won't affect the outcome of the story!

[previewyoutube=XYjicnrOpbo;full][image: KISS GIF][/previewyoutube]

[i][b]Thank you for reading!~[/b][/i]

notes.title: Slippery Flippers: Episode one - Amulet of the Gods Out!
notes.content:
Hello!

It's been a while since our last release, and we're excited to announce[i] Slippery Flippers: Episode One - Amulet of the Gods[/i] has been released!

[i]Slippery Flippers: Episode One - Amulet of the Gods[/i] started as a game jam, and we enjoyed making it so much we've made updates from the game jam version, and have released it here on Steam!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38931050/9d5f1a4091ac8b5f520bc851ac1849cb90f0f2bd.png[/img]

[h1][b]What is it about?[/b][/h1]

[i]Slippery Flippers: Episode One - Amulet of the Gods[/i] is the first in an episodic visual novel series that follows Orlando and his crew (Veda, Walter, and Chip) of outlaws. They're taking on their biggest heist yet: stealing the Amulet of the Gods from a museum, and it's said to have god-like power. While that may be true, their more in it for the fortune they can get by selling the amulet.

Will they be able to succeed in their heist with Riggs and Luca, the local law enforcement, hot on their tails?

Find out by playing our newest gem!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2265650/Slippery_Flippers_Episode_One__Amulet_of_the_Gods/

You may also notice the museums have paintings referencing our other games!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38931050/98f60f454916494f5be562b6f5837c58c9dbadc3.png[/img]

notes.title: The Last Act is here to haunt the Steam Winter Sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38931050/238fdab3c48239a384503b1c14d4ea51a02c146e.png[/img]

Looking for a thrilling romance with mystery?

Want to romance a cute ~spooky~ ghost?

[i]The Last Act[/i] is here!

Jump into Sarah's shoes as she prepares for her lead role and must cope with the mysterious haunting incidences that happen in the theater.

Will she uncover the history of the theater? Will she fall in love with detective Gavin, her co-star Joshua, or the uninvited specter Silas? Only you can decide for her!

notes.title: Not It: Spookiest Edition is OUT!
notes.content:
Hello everyone~

We've finally done it! [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i] is now out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719770/Not_It_Spookiest_Edition/

Our team has been working extra hard to ensure that [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i] is our most polished visual novel to date.

Featuring full English voice acting, tons of CGs to collect, and different endings to explore it's your time to embark on a journey with Katie to her new home in Easthollow. Decide the fate of Easthollow's residents and make meaningful choices around the mysterious centuries-old curse. Is it real? Is it fiction? Only you can decide.

Want to play a spooky ~Halloween~ game without the gore? Take advantage of our new toggle less-gore feature that provides an alternate censored version of our violent CGs!

Thank you all for your support and excitement for this release, and for playing [i]The Last Act[/i]!

We know [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i] is a slightly different genre than [i]The Last Act[/i], but if you decide to pick it up please consider giving us a Steam review!

notes.title: Celebrating the Not It: Spookiest Edition Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone~

Now, we know you are a fan of[i] The Last Act[/i]. A supernatural romance solving mysteries, and possibly falling in love with a detective, your co-star, or an ethereal being. But, we've got another visual novel coming out in ONE WEEK!

We're so excited that our new horror visual novel, [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i], will be releasing in one week on Tuesday, October 12th!

To celebrate this upcoming release, we're doing a sale on all our visual novels! 

Grab our games while they're on sale, and save some time in the ~spooky horror month~ of October to enjoy [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719770/Not_It_Spookiest_Edition/

notes.title: The Last Act Release & Soundtrack
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

[i]The Last Act[/i] has been out for over a month now, and we’re so glad with everyone who's been enjoying our latest visual novel.

One recurring feedback we keep receiving in reviews is that our initial release price of $9.99 is too high, and that people should wait until it’s on sale to buy it. We take all feedback very seriously, and considering the consistency among reviews, we’ve decided to officially lower the price to $4.99.

This decision didn’t come lightly, since we know there are plenty of people who bought it for the original higher price, but we want to show how much we appreciate the feedback and think it’ll be the right decision long-term.

You can find some of our reviews for [i]The Last Act[/i] from curators [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198889833430/recommended/1412180]Otome Lovers[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Kiric12/recommended/1412180]Otome Sekai[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Far2close/recommended/1412180/]Far2Close[/url], and other publications including [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/the-last-act-review/]NookGaming[/url] and [url=https://twohappycats.com/2021/04/06/the-last-act-visual-novel-review/]Two Happy Cats[/url].

If you bought [i]The Last Act[/i] for full price, thank you so much for your support!

When we made the decision to reduce the price, the team looked for ways to thank you for buying the game at the original price. Unfortunately, for people who bought the game here through Steam, we weren’t able to find a way to automatically give you anything for your early support. However, if you forward your Steam receipt to courtney@waddling.co we’ll see what we can do.

On another note, the same reviews also stated how much they adored our custom soundtrack, so we’re going to make it available for purchase! Soon, our soundtrack will be available for purchase here at Steam, so keep your eyes open for it!

But right now you can listen to the original game soundtrack over on [url=https://itunes.apple.com/album/id/1563866924]iTunes[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHnYYFIPDIYSI9JhEi5ANZw]YouTube[/url], [url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B092Z29XXR/]Amazon[/url], [url=https://www.pandora.com/artist/nikita-kryukov/the-last-act-original-game-soundtrack/ALflZ2zZnvmbbvJ]Pandora[/url], and [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/3LcGKTExIREohSKJShKa8m]Spotify[/url].

As always, thank you so much for playing our games and following our developments. We have plans for upcoming releases, including [i]Switch On! Robot Cupid[/i] and one under the project name “Piano Story”, which you can read about over on our upcoming projects devlog on our [url=https://snowhavenstudios.com/the-last-act-is-out-new-projects/]website[/url]!

Make sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SnowhavenStudio]Twitter[/url] to stay up to date on all our progress!
